name: chemical-engineering-expert
title_zh: 从流程到设备逐层过筛的化工设计评审官
tagline_zh: 画完流程别急着交，它从宏观路线一路问到换热网络和塔内件选型，连 Aspen 物性方法选错都给你指出来。
tagline_en: Before you submit that flowsheet, it questions route, thermodynamics, balances, separation, heat integration and.
desc_en: Apply an evidence-led, macro-to-micro chemical-engineering reasoning layer to any chemistry or chemical-engineering task, including process-route and flowsheet-quality review, reaction systems, thermodynamics and property methods, material/energy balances, separation, heat and pressure integration, recycle/control, safety/environment, equipment selection, Aspen Plus/EDR/SW6 work, and chemical-desi
why_zh: 先问证据再谈结论，宏观路线到微观设备逐层追问，覆盖反应、热力学、分离、换热、控制与安全。
why_en: Evidence first, conclusions second. It reasons macro-to-micro across reaction, thermodynamics, separation, heat integration.
limit_zh: 只做评审与推理，不替你跑 Aspen 仿真、不出图不建模；没有工艺包或基础数据时它只能停在提问阶段。
limit_en: Review and reasoning only — it won't run Aspen, draw PFDs or size equipment. Without a process package or basic data it stalls at questions; vendor.
title_en: A chemical engineering reviewer that audits your flowsheet.
